definitions.explanation: The sale of goods in large quantities to retailers or other businesses, rather than directly to consumers.

examples.japanese: {卸|おろし}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{買|か}う→買う：00489_kau⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{卸|おろし}⟦{専門|せんもん}→専門：01251_senmon⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧⟦{客|きゃく}→客：00865_kyaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{入|はい}れない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
examples.english: This store is wholesale only, so regular customers can't enter.

examples.japanese: ⟦{青果|せいか}→青果：14825_seika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{卸|おろし}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→卸業者：17776_oroshigyousha⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦スーパー→スーパー：01061_suupaa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{届|とど}けている→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧。
examples.english: The produce wholesaler delivers vegetables to the supermarket.

notes:
{卸|おろし} refers to the selling of goods in bulk to retailers or businesses, not directly to consumers. Often used in compound forms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧: wholesale selling (the full form)
- ⟦{卸|おろし}{業者|ぎょうしゃ}→卸業者：17776_oroshigyousha⟧: wholesaler
- {卸|おろし}⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧: wholesale price
- ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}{市場|しじょう}→卸売市場：25521_oroshiurishijou⟧: wholesale market
- {卸|おろし}⟦{問屋|とんや}→問屋：07941_tonya⟧: wholesale dealer

SIMILAR WORDS:
Opposite of ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧ (retail). The pair ⟦{卸売|おろしうり}→卸売：05083_oroshiuri⟧ and ⟦{小売|こうり}→小売：05084_kouri⟧ is commonly used to describe the two sides of the distribution chain.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan has famous wholesale markets such as {築地|つきじ}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (Tsukiji Market) and {豊洲|とよす}⟦{市場|しじょう}→市場：09685_shijou⟧ (Toyosu Market) for seafood and produce.
